notes.title: Eldorado FPS: Spooky Halloween Update is Here
notes.content:
Hey survivors! 
Get ready for a chilling adventure as Eldorado FPS brings the spirit of Halloween to life with our latest update! Here's what’s new:

[b]New Halloween Zombies Map[/b]

Face the undead in a brand-new eerie map designed with creepy elements to keep you on edge.

Uncover the horrors lurking behind every corner while battling waves of zombies in a spooky, haunted environment.

[b]Revamped Main Menu – Halloween Edition[/b]

Enjoy a new, festive Halloween-themed main menu, with spooky visuals and atmospheric music to set the perfect tone for this season.

[b]Get Ready for Tricks & Treats[/b]

Beware! The zombies are stronger, and the atmosphere is darker—survive if you can!

More surprises might creep up during your playthrough, so keep your eyes open.
Jump into the action now and embrace the Halloween spirit with our new update! 👻

As always, your feedback means the world to us. Let us know what you think, and happy hunting! 🧟‍♂️

notes.title: Improved Ragdoll Animations for a More Realistic Death Experience!
notes.content:
We’ve just rolled out a new improvement in Eldorado FPS to enhance the immersion and intensity of combat. Our ragdoll animations have been overhauled! Now, when you take down enemies (or meet your own unfortunate end), the character's body reacts more realistically to the environment. Instead of ragdolls flying off in unnatural directions, bodies will now remain more grounded and closer to the point of impact, adding a new layer of realism to the battlefield.

This update is all about making every battle feel more authentic and intense, so jump in, take aim, and see the difference for yourself!

Stay sharp, and see you in the fight!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/47a754e5f036496aa2e643137828f042f5dc7a1e.png[/img]

notes.title: New Mystery Box Update
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce a thrilling new update for Eldorado FPS that will take your zombie mode experience to the next level!

[b]Mystery Box in Zombie Mode[/b]

Get ready for a new twist in zombie mode with the introduction of the Mystery Box! As you battle waves of the undead, you can now unlock the Mystery Box to receive a random mystery weapon. Whether it’s a powerful firearm or a unique weapon you’ve never used before, the Mystery Box adds an element of surprise and excitement to your survival strategy. Will you get the edge you need to push through the next wave? Time to find out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/61a78ed472fa005f58710ccbf7d362d2c7ea61bb.png[/img]

[b]New Main Menu with 3D Environment[/b]

We’ve completely redesigned the main menu to give it a fresh, immersive look. The new main menu features a stunning 3D environment that sets the tone for your gaming experience from the moment you start the game. Navigate through a sleek, updated interface that’s both visually appealing and easy to use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/47a754e5f036496aa2e643137828f042f5dc7a1e.png[/img]

In addition to these exciting new features, we’ve also addressed several bugs to ensure a smoother, more enjoyable gameplay experience. Your feedback has been crucial in helping us identify and resolve these issues, and we’re committed to delivering the best possible experience

Don’t wait download the update now and dive into the enhanced world of Eldorado FPS. Between the new Mystery Box, the revamped main menu, and the bug fixes, there’s never been a better time to play!

notes.title: New Profile System
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that a brand-new update for Eldorado FPS is now live! This update brings a host of exciting features and improvements that we can't wait for you to experience. Here’s what’s new:

[b]New Player Profile with Enhanced Statistics[/b]
Dive deeper into your performance with our revamped player profile. Track your progress and achievements with a comprehensive set of statistics that provide insights into your gameplay like never before. The new player profile now includes:

[b]Zombie Mode Records:[/b] Monitor your survival records in both online and offline zombie modes. Keep track of how many waves you’ve survived, your highest wave, and the total time you’ve lasted in these intense modes.

[b]Player Stats:[/b] Stay informed about your in-game accomplishments with detailed statistics. Check out your player experience, current level, total kills, total deaths, and assists. This detailed breakdown helps you understand your strengths and areas for improvement.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
We’ve squashed some bugs in the zombie mode to ensure a smoother and more enjoyable gaming experience. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify and resolve these issues.

Download the update now and immerse yourself in the enhanced features of Eldorado FPS. Thank you for your continued support and dedication. Keep surviving, and we’ll see you in the game!

Happy gaming!

notes.title: Immersive Experience Update
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce a significant update to Eldorado FPS, bringing a range of exciting new features to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what you can look forward to in the latest version:

[img]https://i.ibb.co/ZHv056X/Screenshot-2024-06-11-193410.png[/img]

[b]New Main Menu[/b]
We’ve revamped the main menu with a stunning 3D environment. Now, when you start the game, you'll be greeted by your character standing in this immersive setting, setting the stage for the adventures ahead.

[b]Voice System for Characters[/b]
Our characters have found their voices! We’ve implemented a voice system that includes both male and female voices. This addition brings a new level of realism and immersion to the game, allowing you to hear your character’s reactions and interactions throughout your journey.

[b]Enhanced Gun Sound Effects[/b]
We know how crucial sound is to creating an intense and immersive FPS experience. That’s why we’ve updated the gun sound effects to make every shot more impactful and realistic. Each weapon now has its unique sound, enhancing the overall gameplay experience.

[b]Footsteps Sound System[/b]
To further immerse you in the world of Eldorado, we’ve added a footsteps sound system. Now, you can hear the distinct sounds of your character’s steps, whether they’re running through the dense area or sneaking through the ruins. This feature adds a layer of tactical awareness and realism to your movements.

[i]We hope you enjoy these new features and enhancements. As always, we appreciate your feedback and support. Dive in, explore the updates, and let us know what you think![/i]

notes.title: A Year of Exciting Enhancements and Updates!
notes.content:
[h2]Upcoming Updates for Eldorado FPS: A Year of Exciting Enhancements![/h2]

[b]New Profile System[/b]
We're thrilled to introduce a comprehensive new profile system to enhance your gameplay experience. Here's what you can expect:

[b]Player Avatars[/b]: Showcase your unique style with customizable avatars displayed prominently on your player profile.

[b]Zombie Survival Stats[/b]: Track your progress with detailed zombie survival stats, including:
  - The number of waves you've survived.
  - Your highest wave achieved.
  - Total survival time, with separate stats for offline and co-op modes.

[b]General Gameplay Stats[/b]: Keep tabs on your performance across all game modes (excluding zombie mode):
  - Total kills, deaths, and assists.
  - Kill/Death ratio.
  - Player level, experience points, and current rank.

[b]Additional In-Game Currency[/b]
Earn new in-game currency during matches, which you can use to purchase exclusive store items in the future. This currency adds an extra layer of strategy and reward to your gameplay.

[b]Loot Boxes[/b]
Explore zombie maps to find and purchase loot boxes with game coins. Each box contains a random weapon that could turn the tide in your favor. Keep an eye out for these valuable finds!

[b]Global Chat System[/b]
Connect with players across your region with our new global chat system. Engage in conversations, form alliances, and share your experiences right from the main menu.

[b]Advanced Friends System[/b]
Enhance your social experience with the advanced friends system. Add friends during matchmaking, making it easier to team up and strategize together.

[b]Leaderboard Competition[/b]
Compete for the top spot on the new zombie survival mode leaderboard. Show off your skills and see how you stack up against the best players in the community.

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
Log in daily to receive game coins and other exciting rewards. Consistent play will be rewarded, giving you more reasons to come back every day.

[b]Roulette[/b]
Try your luck with the roulette feature to win amazing in-game items. Spin the wheel and see what fortune has in store for you!

[b]Advanced Matchmaking System[/b]
Experience fairer and more balanced matches with our advanced matchmaking system. It pairs you with players of similar skill levels, ensuring a competitive and enjoyable game.

[b]Achievements[/b]
Complete a variety of Steam achievements designed to challenge and reward you for your dedication and skill. Aim high and collect them all!

[b]Daily Tasks[/b]
Receive new daily tasks to complete for additional rewards. These tasks add a dynamic element to your gameplay, encouraging you to explore different aspects of the game.

[b]New Deathmatch Mode[/b]
Get ready for a thrilling new deathmatch mode that features not only player-versus-player combat but also zombie threats. Survive against both humans and the undead in this intense mode.

[b]New Melee Weapons[/b]
Prepare to wield powerful new melee weapons, including the fearsome chainsaw. These additions bring new strategies and brutal combat options to your arsenal.

[b]New Heavy Guns[/b]
Unleash devastation with new heavy guns like the MiniGun. These powerful weapons will change the dynamics of combat, providing even more ways to dominate the battlefield.

Stay tuned for these exciting updates, and thank you for being a part of the Eldorado FPS community. We can't wait to bring you these enhancements and continue to make Eldorado FPS the ultimate gaming experience!

notes.title: Survive the Extremes: New Maps and Features Now Available in Zombie Mode!
notes.content:
We are excited to announce the release of our latest updates, designed to take your zombie survival experience to the next level! Here’s what’s new in the game:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/539a8cf7bca6bfcb48c47fb7c56c76a8e6e9c19f.png[/img]

[b]Introducing Two New Maps: Zombie Nightfall & Dayfall[/b]  
Dive into our two brand-new maps! "Zombie Nightfall" envelops you in the thrilling challenge of surviving under the cover of darkness, while "Dayfall" offers a stark contrast with its bright, daylight setting. Whether you prefer the suspense of night or the clarity of day, these maps provide fresh environments for both solo and co-op play.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/942785e23c92dff357028bbecf65a2f5e7077103.png[/img]

[b]Enhanced Barricade System[/b]
  Experience our newly integrated barricade system in zombie mode. Strategically place and repair barricades to fend off zombie breaches and secure your survival.

[b]Customizable Zombie Shop System[/b]
  Tailor your survival strategy with our expanded Zombie Shop System. Select from a variety of weapons and attachments to equip yourself against the undead onslaught.

[b]Smarter Zombies with Advanced AI[/b]
  Brace yourself against smarter, more agile zombies. Enhanced AI means zombies now pursue players more aggressively, adapting to their movements and overcoming obstacles to maintain the chase.

[b]Bug Fixes and Performance Enhancements[/b]
  Enjoy smoother gameplay with critical bug fixes, including improvements to weapon reloading animations and real-time updates to player statistics.

These updates are live now! Jump back into the game and test your survival skills across our new maps and systems. We look forward to your feedback and hope you enjoy these enhancements as much as we enjoyed developing them. Gear up, strategize, and survive the apocalypse—day or night!

notes.title: NIGHTFALL
notes.content:
[h3][b]Exciting New Features Coming in Our Latest Game Update!
[/b][/h3]

[b]-Introducing "Nightfall" – A New Zombie Map:[/b] Dive into "Nightfall," our brand-new map set under the cover of darkness. This thrilling nighttime setting challenges players to survive relentless zombie waves, either solo or in co-op mode with friends. Navigate through the shadowy terrain and keep the undead at bay for as long as you can.

[b]New Barricade System in Zombie Mode:[/b] Enhance your defensive strategies with our new barricade system. Zombies will now attack from specific areas, and players can place barricades to block their path and slow their advance. Stay alert as you'll need to repair these barricades once they're damaged to keep the horde at a distance.

[b]Zombie Shop System:[/b] Gain more control over how you fight with our new Zombie Shop system. Equip yourself for survival by purchasing a variety of weapons and attachments. Customize your arsenal to suit your playstyle and maximize your chances of survival against the increasingly cunning zombie hordes.

[b]Advanced Zombie AI:[/b] Experience a new level of challenge with our improved zombie AI. These smarter zombies can now follow you to higher ground, jumping and navigating obstacles just as you do. There’s no escaping their pursuit, so keep moving and stay one step ahead.

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/b] We’ve also squashed some pesky bugs in this update. Issues with the weapon reloading animation and delays in updating player statistics have been addressed. Along with these, various other minor bugs have been fixed to enhance your gameplay experience.

We’re excited for you to experience these enhancements. Stay tuned for the release, and as always, we value your feedback to help us keep improving the game. Enjoy the night and fight the fright in "Nightfall"!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.2
notes.content:
We're thrilled to roll out the latest updates to enhance your gaming experience:

[b]Headshot Mechanic Enhancement[/b]:
We've enhanced the headshot system to reward precision shooting. Players can now take down enemies with a single bullet to the head, making every shot count even more. Aim true and make each bullet a potential game-changer in your battles!

[b]Loadout Animation Overhaul[/b]: Check out the revamped animations in the loadout section! Characters now dynamically display their equipped firearms, adding a new layer of realism to your gear selection.

[b]Zombie Spawn Fix[/b]: We've resolved the issue where zombies failed to spawn after a game restart, ensuring a seamless and uninterrupted zombie-slaying adventure.

[b]Killstreak Option Removal in Zombie Mode[/b]: To streamline gameplay and focus on survival tactics, we've removed the killstreak options from Zombie Mode. This change will enhance the core survival experience.

[b]Free Character Apparel[/b]: Expand your wardrobe with free clothing options now available for both male and female characters. Refresh your look as you battle it out in style!

[b]Steam Profile Picture Integration[/b]: We've added a personal touch to the game's main menu! Now, your Steam profile picture will be displayed, helping you feel more at home while navigating the game interface. Enjoy this new feature that brings your Steam identity right into the heart of the game!

[b]Additional Bug Fixes[/b]: This patch also includes a variety of bug fixes to improve game stability and performance. These adjustments address minor issues across different areas of the game, ensuring a smoother and more enjoyable experience.
We hope you enjoy these updates! Keep the feedback coming so we can continue to improve and refine your gaming experience.


[i][b]We hope you enjoy these updates! Keep the feedback coming so we can continue to improve and refine your gaming experience.[/b][/i]

notes.title: Eldorado FPS Character Customization Update is Live Now!
notes.content:
We're excited to announce that the highly anticipated character customization update for Eldorado FPS is officially here! Dive into a world where you can create and tailor your character to reflect your unique style and strategy.

🌟 Special Launch Offer! 🌟
For a limited time, celebrate the release with an exclusive offer: every item in our in-game shop, from trendy clothes to cool accessories, is available for just 250 game coins each! Don't miss out on the chance to deck out your character with some fresh gear at an unbeatable price.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44905998/fe67d9fd8a09105bbfa75f6cec6f4ada0668404c.png[/img]

🎨 Unleash Your Creativity 🎨
Take advantage of our expansive customization options:

Detailed Customization: Fine-tune your character’s appearance, from body shape to facial features.
Fashion Forward: Explore a variety of clothing options including shirts, pants, shoes, and hats.
Accessorize: Add the finishing touches with new hairstyles, beards, glasses, masks, and more.
Step into the game now and start crafting a character that truly represents you. Whether you're gearing up for competitive play or just looking to stand out from the crowd, now's the perfect time to make your mark.

Get ready, get set, and customize! Your ideal shooter awaits in Eldorado FPS. Let the games begin!

notes.title: Announcing New Character Customization
notes.content:
Attention! Get ready to dive into a world of endless possibilities with our latest game update, launching on April 25, 2024. We're thrilled to introduce a groundbreaking feature that will redefine your gameplay experience – a brand-new character creation system!

[h3]Customize Your Character
[/h3]
From the moment you step into the game, you’ll have the power to craft your unique combatant. Choose from a diverse range of options to shape your character's gender, body, and face. Whether you want to mirror your real-life persona or create an entirely fantastical figure, the tools at your disposal will let you tailor every aspect to your liking.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/RBD4cyx/Character-System-Update.gif[/img]


[h3]Style Your Character
[/h3]
But that’s not all! Your character's style will be just as customizable as their features. Head over to our in-game shop to browse through an extensive collection of fashionable attire. From sleek shirts and pants to stylish shoes and hats, you can outfit your character to match your battlefield tactics or personal flair. Don’t forget to check out the new hairstyles and beards, and accessorize with glasses, masks, and more to complete your look.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/D9NkMGY/Character-System-Update2.gif[/img]


[h3]More to Explore
[/h3]
This update is just the beginning! We have a plethora of additional content lined up, ensuring that the world of Eldorado FPS continues to expand and excite. Keep your gear ready, and prepare for a gaming experience where you control every element of your character's appearance and style.

Mark your calendars for April 25, 2024, and get ready to unleash your creativity in Eldorado FPS like never before. See you on the battlefield!

notes.title: Patch 0.0.1
notes.content: We've made significant improvements to the Rocket Launcher in our latest patch. Issues with explosion effects and range have been addressed, and close-range damage has been fine-tuned for better consistency. Enjoy a more reliable and effective Rocket Launcher during your gameplay!

notes.title: Explore Our New Map
notes.content:
We're excited to unveil a brand-new map, designed to enhance your gaming experience! This latest addition offers a fresh playground for all game modes, providing new challenges, and excitement. Dive in and discover everything our new map has to offer, whether you're competing, or just exploring. Join us and see how this new terrain transforms your gameplay!

notes.title: Introducing Zombie Survival Mode!
notes.content:
[b]Dive[/b] into the all-new Zombie Survival mode where endurance is key! Prepare to face endless waves of zombies, each bringing unique challenges to test your survival skills. Whether you choose to brave it alone or team up with friends, you'll need to defend, survive, and conquer as many waves as possible. Teamwork shines in this mode—collaborate, strategize, and protect each other to survive the relentless zombie onslaught. How long can you last? Join us in Zombie Survival and push your limits!
